The console has a dark wood finish on the left side with drawers and shelves.
The right side is a light-colored wooden or laminate surface with a black TV screen.

risks.risk: The TV screen may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the TV screen showing the display and any cracks or dead pixels.

risks.risk: The console may have structural damage, loose joints, or missing parts.
risks.proof: A photo showing the underside and all sides of the console, including the back and legs.

risks.risk: The flat-screen TV may not be the advertised model or brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the TV's back or side showing the brand and model name.

risks.risk: The console may have hidden stains, scratches, or wear not visible in the current lighting.
risks.proof: A photo taken in direct sunlight or with a flashlight to reveal surface imperfections.

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the TV screen to check for damage or functionality.
A photo of the TV's back or side to confirm the brand and model.
A photo showing the entire console from all angles, including the back and legs.
A photo taken in direct sunlight to reveal any hidden stains or scratches.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
